lessons.culture: In the Gulf a flat is often described by its rooms: "غرفتين وصالة" means two bedrooms and a living hall. Rent is usually agreed for a year in a written lease (عقد إيجار), and a deposit (تأمين) is paid that is returned at the end if nothing is damaged. Always ask whether water and electricity are included before you sign.

lessons.culture: In Islam a neighbour has a great right. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that Jibril kept advising him about the neighbour until he thought the neighbour would be made an heir. Gulf neighbours share food, visit one another when ill and say "أبشر" when asked a favour. Sending a dish to the new family next door is a common way to start a friendship.

challenge.title: Viewing a Flat
challenge.instructions: Write and act out a conversation of at least 10 lines where you ask a landlord about a flat for rent. Ask the monthly rent, the number of bedrooms, the floor and whether there is a lift, ask whether water and electricity are included, ask to view the flat and whether it is furnished, find the kitchen, and say what you decide. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 18.
required_elements: A question about the rent or the number of bedrooms with بكم or كم.
A question about the floor, the lift or whether water and electricity are included.
A request to see the flat with أقدر أشوف.
A question about the kitchen or the furniture with وين or مفروشة.
A closing decision with باخذها or أبي عقد سنة.

dialogue.speaker: Salem
dialogue.arabic: السلام عليكم. أدور شقة للإيجار. بكم الإيجار في الشهر؟

dialogue.english: Peace be upon you. I am looking for a flat to rent. How much is the rent a month?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.arabic: وعليكم السلام. ألفين وخمسمية درهم، وفيها غرفتين وصالة.

dialogue.english: And peace be upon you. Two thousand five hundred dirhams, and it has two bedrooms and a hall.

dialogue.transliteration: agdar ashoof ish-shigga? w ish-shigga mafroosha?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.arabic: تفضل. لا، ما فيها أثاث. المطبخ جنب الصالة.
dialogue.transliteration: tfaDDal. la, ma feeha athaath. il-maTbakh jamb iS-Saala.
dialogue.english: Please. No, it has no furniture. The kitchen is next to the hall.

dialogue.speaker: Salem
dialogue.arabic: الشقة حلوة وواسعة. زين، باخذها. أبي عقد سنة.

dialogue.english: The flat is nice and spacious. Good, I will take it. I want a one-year lease.
